MCON.description: Linear Constraints (MCON). Each ITEMS entry defines one constraint whose per-slave fields depend on TYPE: TYPE=EX uses DOF/COEFF and encodes constrained DOFs in SLAVE_TYPE as a 6-flag string, while TYPE=WD uses WEIGHT and SLAVE_TYPE as a single DOF index number.

ITEMS.description: List of linear-constraint items. Each item is applied to the master node given by the entity key.

ID.description: Serial number of the constraint under the master node. 0 (or omitted) lets the program pick/match by condition.

GROUP_NAME.description: Boundary group name. Must be an existing boundary group; empty string means no group.

SLAVE_TYPE.description: Constrained DOF specifier, given as a string. [TYPE=EX] a 6-digit flag string of 0/1 ordered DX DY DZ RX RY RZ (e.g. "100000" = DX); the first '1' from the left selects the constrained DOF. [TYPE=WD] a single DOF index number as a string (0=DX,1=DY,2=DZ,3=RX,4=RY,5=RZ).

TYPE.description: Constraint type (case-insensitive). "EX" = Explicit (uses per-slave DOF and COEFF), "WD" = Weighted Displacement (uses per-slave WEIGHT).

SLAVES.description: Independent (slave) nodes making up the constraint equation.

NODE_KEY.description: Node number of the independent node.

COEFF.description: [TYPE=EX] Constraint coefficient for this slave node's DOF.

WEIGHT.description: [TYPE=WD] Weight factor for this slave node.

DOF.description: [TYPE=EX] DOF index of this slave node (0=DX,1=DY,2=DZ,3=RX,4=RY,5=RZ).
